findings.sentence: Professor Venet Osmani of Queen Mary University of London named the volume problem exactly — the number of colonoscopies performed nearly doubled after the AI tool was introduced, going from 795 to 1382 — and questioned whether a true loss of skill could happen in three months, a very short period for a clinician with over 27 years of experience.
findings.why: The page states the nineteen endoscopists averaged 27.6 years since graduation over a range of 8 to 39, so characterising the group as having 'over 27 years of experience' contradicts the stated mean of 27.6 and the range that includes endoscopists with as few as 8 years.
findings.other: The nineteen endoscopists involved were not novices: each had performed more than 2,000 colonoscopies, and they averaged 27.6 years since graduation, over a range of 8 to 39.
